description: Per-page transcription-coverage checks of Hebrew Wikisource ProofreadPage pages against their scans (F8b3). Coverage is a scope fact, not an attestation: full_page means the text covers the whole printed body; partial_page means a printed block is not transcribed (what is missing is described in words) and the page is marked needs_crop (decision 12). Each check is pinned to the page revision and the Commons file SHA-1; a check by a human overrides an agent check of the same page. No page text or images are stored here.
sample: All 48 quality-4 pages passing every other gate, plus up to 9 evenly spaced quality-3 pages from each of the 12 admitted Indexes with the most such pages (156 pages).

methods.agent_render_compare_900px: Viewed the Commons render of the pinned file's page at 900 px and compared it with the page's wikisource_plain_text.v2 text: the start and end of the body and every printed block (columns, footnotes, side notes, verse, translation). Running heads, page numbers, catchwords, signature marks and library or digitization stamps are outside the body.
methods.agent_crop_review_960px: Viewed the Commons render of the pinned file's page at 960 px, annotated with the coverage tool's OCR line boxes and crop and a grid in page coordinates, and compared it with the page's wikisource_plain_text.v2 text: the start and end of the body and every printed block. For a partial page, confirmed the tool's crop or placed or corrected the box or regions (agent_visual_crop.v1), checking each corrected or placed crop on a preview of the pair image (regions kept, the rest of the box masked). Running heads, page numbers, catchwords, signature marks and library or digitization stamps are outside the body. A geometry and scope check, not an attestation of the text (F8b5).
methods.agent_text_review_960px: Viewed the Commons render of the pinned file's page at 960 px (zoomed where needed) and compared every footnote of the page's faithful wikisource_plain_text.v2 text (its [n] lines) with the page: a note whose text is printed on the page (at the foot, in a margin, or as an inset gloss) is printed; a note with no printed counterpart (an editor's remark, correction, cross-reference, citation, identification or translation) is recorded in unprinted_notes, by its number in the faithful conversion, and dropped from the pair text with its mark. Text not visible on the scan (an ink blot, a gutter shadow) is recorded as excluded_spans, by offsets in the pair text and boxes on the page. Words in the text the page does not show (an editor's heading, paraphrase or emendation) are recorded as text_not_on_page. A text check, not an attestation, and it decides no coverage (F8b7).
methods.agent_tool_verdict_spot_check_960px: Stratified spot check of the coverage tool's full_page verdicts (F8b7): viewed the Commons render of the pinned file's page at 960 px, cropped to the print, and compared it with the page's wikisource_plain_text.v2 text: the first and last body lines and every printed block (rubrics in small type, headings, marginal repetition marks, footnotes). Running heads, page numbers and catchwords are outside the body. Also records footnotes found not printed, text not visible on the scan, and words the page does not show. A geometry and scope check, not an attestation of the text.
